rounds.text: Remus Pharmaceuticals is exhibiting exceptional growth, with year-over-year sales increasing by 145% and net profit by 32% [E51, E53], while maintaining a superior ROCE of 16.8% compared to the sector median of 12.6% [E10, E61]. Despite this momentum, the company appears under-appreciated as recent profit growth has begun to outpace share price appreciation [E45], and it maintains a high rules-based screen score of 81 out of 100 [E50]. The company’s financial health is exemplary, being almost debt-free with a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.08x [E47, E25] and showing a significant improvement in debtor days from 107 to 59.8 [E48]. Institutional and insider confidence is rising, with promoters increasing their stake to 70.95% [E29] and foreign institutions more than doubling their holding to 5.28% [E30]. Conceded: the quarterly operating margin recently declined to 7% [E18] and cash conversion remains low at 0.39x [E21]. This setup is supported by a strong healthcare sector tailwind [E58] and a perfect relative-strength rating of 100 against the Nifty 500 [E39]. Finally, the stock maintains a bullish technical profile, trading above both its 50-day and 200-day moving averages [E38].
